page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the e2 server family. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs, mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon cores running at 2.2 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates a balanced performance profile. The instance achieves strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU scores fall within the average range. Single-threaded tasks show some limitations, with Geekbench single-core, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression scores ranking in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests, including read-only and write operations on large blocks, consistently register average performance.

With its balanced resource allocation, the e2-standard-32 is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-speed local NVMe storage. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, where it demonstrates average throughput and processing capabilities. It can also handle small to medium language model inference tasks at moderate token generation speeds.
